lines.text: Many learners say: He said me the news.
Better: He told me the news.
Say told me. Said needs no me.
Told me! She told me the answer.

data.why: Say told me. Said needs no me.

native.tip: say 后面不能直接接人；“告诉某人”要用 tell/told + 人。
native.caption: 你是不是也会说 “He said me the news.”😅 say 后面不能直接接人，“告诉我”要用 told me：“He told me the news.”跟着 Ama 老师读一读！在 Lexkite 应用里练习更多。

en.tip: Say cannot take a person right after it. Use tell: told me.
en.caption: Do you say “He said me the news.” 😅 Say cannot take a person right after it, so use told: “He told me the news.” Listen to Ama and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
